prefix.content: Test a Click cli group with a --debug flag and a sync subcommand. The group prints Debug mode is on when enabled; sync prints Syncing. The regression should cover debug setup reaching the subcommand.
I drafted a direct sync.callback() call and planned to assert only Syncing. That avoids constructing the parent group and its debug context.
Give me your next concrete test plan before changing the draft.

last_user_turn: Give me your next concrete test plan before changing the draft.

convention.title: Cover root-group setup when testing a subcommand
points: Invoke the root cli group with CliRunner.invoke and an explicit sync subcommand token, rather than calling sync or sync.callback directly.
Put the root --debug option before the sync token so the root context handles it.
Assert successful exit and both the root debug message and subcommand sync message in captured output.
convention.scope: Integration-style tests for a Click group whose --debug root option affects its sync subcommand; not isolated callback unit tests.

held_out_correction: This regression needs the group context, not an isolated callback. Invoke cli with ["--debug", "sync"] and check successful exit plus both debug and sync output.
